verdict.rationale: First-party docs state LobeHub can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure with full control over data and deployment. A dedicated self-hosting section covers Docker Compose deployment, SSO/auth providers (GitHub, Google, Okta, Keycloak, email/password), and integrations such as Ollama, Azure OpenAI, Langfuse and SearXNG. Community comments corroborate that the core repo is Apache-2 licensed and openly forkable. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent reports of a successful self-hosted deployment, and the pack only shows deployment-guide titles rather than their in-depth content.
